market_positions.segment_name: Combined chronic care markets (AWC, OC, CC, IC)
market_positions.source_note: Company operates in four chronic care categories with combined market size of c.$15.5 billion p.a. and market growth rates varying between 4-8% p.a. Company states it is among a small number of leaders in categories it operates.
Company cites SmartTRAK data and Convatec estimate that non-DFU/VLU indications comprise c.55% of the US wound biologics segment. No absolute TAM figure disclosed by company.
